feature.description: Improves storage, retrieval, citation, and evidence binding. Validate with recall, precision, citation accuracy, and provenance checks.

contract.purpose_user_function: Improve memory storage, retrieval ranking, citations, and evidence binding using measured retrieval quality.

contract.expected_outputs: Candidate memory/retrieval configuration or model, recall/precision/citation/provenance metrics, and gated recommendation.
contract.state_side_effects: May update indexes or approved retrieval configuration and writes evaluation/evolution evidence.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Provenance loss, contamination, citation mismatch, recall/precision regression, or policy failure rejects candidate.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Memory/index/evidence systems exist; Self-RAG and reranker training implementations were not found as shipped training pipelines.
contract.success_evidence: Holdout retrieval metrics improve while every returned item retains valid provenance/citation references.
